passages.text: At the Sheep Gate, Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding. They dedicated it and installed its doors. After building as far as the Tower of the Hundred and the Tower of Hananel, they dedicated the wall.
passages.sermon:
Eliashib was the high priest.
His fellow priests worked with him.
They began to rebuild the Sheep Gate.
They dedicated the Sheep Gate to God.
They set up its doors.
They built the wall as far as the Tower of the Hundred.
They dedicated the wall up to the Tower of the Hundred.
They built the wall as far as the Tower of Hananel.
They dedicated the wall up to the Tower of Hananel.
passages.original: וַיָּ֡קָם אֶלְיָשִׁיב֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וַיִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־ שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֵ֣מָּה קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֖ידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֑יו וְעַד־ מִגְדַּ֤ל הַמֵּאָה֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ עַ֖ד מִגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: The men of Jericho built next to Eliashib, and Zaccur son of Imri built next to them.
passages.sermon:
Eliashib was the high priest.
He led the rebuilding at the Sheep Gate.
The men of Jericho built next to Eliashib.
Zaccur was the son of Imri.
Zaccur built next to the men of Jericho.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָד֥וֹ בָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹס וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ בָנָ֔ה זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־ אִמְרִֽי׃ס

passages.text: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Hassenaah rebuilt the Fish Gate.
They laid the beams of the gate.
They installed the doors of the gate.
They put in the bolts.
They put in the bars.
passages.original: וְאֵת֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י הַסְּנָאָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעוּלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: Next to them, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, made repairs. Next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel, made repairs; and next to him, Zadok son of Baana made repairs as well.
passages.sermon:
Meremoth was the son of Uriah.
Uriah was the son of Hakkoz.
Meremoth made repairs.
He worked next to the previous builders.
Meshullam was the son of Berechiah.
Berechiah was the son of Meshezabel.
Meshullam made repairs.
He worked next to Meremoth.
Zadok was the son of Baana.
Zadok made repairs.
He worked next to Meshullam.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן־ אוּרִיָּה֙ בֶּן־ הַקּ֔וֹץס וְעַל־ יָדָ֣ם הֶחֱזִ֔יק מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־ בֶּרֶכְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֑לס וְעַל־ יָדָ֣ם הֶֽחֱזִ֔יק צָד֖וֹק בֶּֽן־ בַּעֲנָֽא׃ס

passages.text: Next to him, the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.
passages.sermon:
The Tekoites worked next to him.
The Tekoites made repairs.
The nobles of the Tekoites did not help.
The nobles did not join the work.
The nobles did not work under their supervisors.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֖ם הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑ים וְאַדִּֽירֵיהֶם֙ לֹא־ הֵבִ֣יאוּ צַוָּרָ֔ם בַּעֲבֹדַ֖ת אֲדֹנֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
passages.sermon:
Joiada was the son of Paseah.
Meshullam was the son of Besodeiah.
Joiada and Meshullam repaired the Jeshanah Gate.
They laid the beams of the gate.
They installed the doors of the gate.
They installed the bolts of the gate.
They installed the bars of the gate.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַיְשָׁנָ֜ה הֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ יֽוֹיָדָע֙ בֶּן־ פָּסֵ֔חַ וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם בֶּן־ בְּסֽוֹדְיָ֑ה הֵ֣מָּה קֵר֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו וּמַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: Next to them, repairs were made by Melatiah the Gibeonite, Jadon the Meronothite, and the men of Gibeon and Mizpah, who were under the authority of the governor of the region west of the Euphrates.
passages.sermon:
Melatiah was a Gibeonite.
Jadon was a Meronothite.
The men of Gibeon helped them.
The men of Mizpah also helped them.
They all made repairs.
They worked next to the previous builders.
The governor ruled the region west of the Euphrates.
These men worked under the governor’s authority.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֨ם הֶחֱזִ֜יק מְלַטְיָ֣ה הַגִּבְעֹנִ֗י וְיָדוֹן֙ הַמֵּרֹ֣נֹתִ֔י אַנְשֵׁ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן וְהַמִּצְפָּ֑ה לְכִסֵּ֕א פַּחַ֖ת עֵ֥בֶר הַנָּהָֽר׃ס

passages.text: Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs, and next to him, Hananiah son of the perfumer made repairs. They fortified Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
passages.sermon:
Uzziel was the son of Harhaiah.
Uzziel was a goldsmith.
Uzziel made repairs next to the previous workers.
Hananiah was the son of a perfumer.
Hananiah made repairs next to Uzziel.
They strengthened Jerusalem.
They worked until they reached the Broad Wall.
passages.original: עַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֻזִּיאֵ֤ל בֶּֽן־ חַרְהֲיָה֙ צֽוֹרְפִ֔יםס וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חֲנַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ הָרַקָּחִ֑ים וַיַּֽעַזְבוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַחוֹמָ֥ה הָרְחָבָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Next to them, Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs; next to him, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house; and next to him, Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs.
passages.sermon:
Rephaiah was the son of Hur.
Rephaiah ruled half of the district of Jerusalem.
Rephaiah made repairs next to the others.
Jedaiah was the son of Harumaph.
Jedaiah made repairs next to Rephaiah.
Jedaiah repaired the section across from his own house.
Hattush was the son of Hashabneiah.
Hattush made repairs next to Jedaiah.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָדָ֤ם הֶחֱזִיק֙ רְפָיָ֣ה בֶן־ ח֔וּר שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס וְעַל־ יָדָ֧ם הֶחֱזִ֛יק יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן־ חֲרוּמַ֖ף וְנֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹס וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֔יק חַטּ֖וּשׁ בֶּן־ חֲשַׁבְנְיָֽה׃

passages.text: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-moab repaired another section, as well as the Tower of the Ovens.
passages.sermon:
Malchijah was the son of Harim.
Hasshub was the son of Pahath-moab.
Malchijah and Hasshub repaired another section of the wall.
They also repaired the Tower of the Ovens.
passages.original: מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֗ית הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן־ חָרִ֔ם וְחַשּׁ֖וּב בֶּן־ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ת מִגְדַּ֥ל הַתַּנּוּרִֽים׃ס

passages.text: And next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the other half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs, with the help of his daughters.
passages.sermon:
Shallum was the son of Hallohesh.
Shallum was the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem.
Shallum made repairs to the wall.
Shallum’s daughters helped him make these repairs.
Shallum and his daughters worked next to the others.
passages.original: וְעַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק שַׁלּוּם֙ בֶּן־ הַלּוֹחֵ֔שׁ שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם ה֖וּא וּבְנוֹתָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: The Valley Gate was repaired by Hanun and the residents of Zanoah. They rebuilt it, installed its doors, bolts, and bars, and repaired a thousand cubits of the wall as far as the Dung Gate.
passages.sermon:
Hanun repaired the Valley Gate.
The residents of Zanoah helped Hanun.
Hanun and the residents of Zanoah rebuilt the Valley Gate.
They installed the doors of the Valley Gate.
They installed the bolts of the Valley Gate.
They installed the bars of the Valley Gate.
They repaired one thousand cubits of the wall.
They repaired the wall from the Valley Gate to the Dung Gate.
passages.original: אֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הַגַּ֜יְא הֶחֱזִ֣יק חָנוּן֮ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י זָנוֹחַ֒ הֵ֣מָּה בָנ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֙ידוּ֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְאֶ֤לֶף אַמָּה֙ בַּחוֹמָ֔ה עַ֖ד שַׁ֥עַר הָשֲׁפֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem. He rebuilt it and installed its doors, bolts, and bars.
passages.sermon:
Malchijah was the son of Rechab.
Malchijah was the ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem.
Malchijah repaired the Dung Gate.
Malchijah rebuilt the Dung Gate.
Malchijah installed the doors of the Dung Gate.
Malchijah installed the bolts of the Dung Gate.
Malchijah installed the bars of the Dung Gate.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ שַׁ֣עַר הָאַשְׁפּ֗וֹת הֶחֱזִיק֙ מַלְכִּיָּ֣ה בֶן־ רֵכָ֔ב שַׂ֖ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־ הַכָּ֑רֶם ה֣וּא יִבְנֶ֔נּוּ וְיַעֲמִיד֙ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָֽיו׃ס

passages.text: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Col-hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofed it, and installed its doors, bolts, and bars. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Shelah near the king’s garden, as far as the stairs that descend from the City of David.
passages.sermon:
Shallun was the son of Col-hozeh.
Shallun was the ruler of the district of Mizpah.
Shallun repaired the Fountain Gate.
He rebuilt the gate.
He roofed the gate.
He installed its doors.
He installed its bolts.
He installed its bars.
He repaired the wall of the Pool of Shelah.
The Pool of Shelah was near the king’s garden.
He repaired the wall as far as the stairs.
The stairs descend from the City of David.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ שַׁ֨עַר הָעַ֜יִן הֶ֠חֱזִיק שַׁלּ֣וּן בֶּן־ כָּל־ חֹזֶה֮ שַׂ֣ר פֶּ֣לֶךְ הַמִּצְפָּה֒ ה֤וּא יִבְנֶ֙נּוּ֙ וִיטַֽלְלֶ֔נּוּ וְיַעֲמִידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֔יו מַנְעֻלָ֖יו וּבְרִיחָ֑יו וְ֠אֵת חוֹמַ֞ת בְּרֵכַ֤ת הַשֶּׁ֙לַח֙ לְגַן־ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְעַד־ הַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת הַיּוֹרְד֖וֹת מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד׃ס

passages.text: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth-zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Mighty.
passages.sermon:
Nehemiah was the son of Azbuk.
Nehemiah was the ruler of a half-district of Beth-zur.
Nehemiah made repairs beyond the previous section.
He repaired up to a point opposite the tombs of David.
He repaired as far as the artificial pool.
He repaired as far as the House of the Mighty.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ נְחֶמְיָ֣ה בֶן־ עַזְבּ֔וּק שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּֽית־ צ֑וּר עַד־ נֶ֙גֶד֙ קִבְרֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד וְעַד־ הַבְּרֵכָה֙ הָעֲשׂוּיָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֵּ֥ית הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃ס

passages.text: Next to him, the Levites made repairs under Rehum son of Bani, and next to him, Hashabiah, ruler of a half-district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.
passages.sermon:
The Levites worked on the repairs.
Rehum son of Bani led the Levites.
They worked next to the previous section.
Hashabiah worked beside them.
Hashabiah ruled half the district of Keilah.
He repaired the part that belonged to his district.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם רְח֣וּם בֶּן־ בָּנִ֑י עַל־ יָד֣וֹ הֶחֱזִ֗יק חֲשַׁבְיָ֛ה שַׂר־ חֲצִי־ פֶ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָ֖ה לְפִלְכּֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Next to him, their countrymen made repairs under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.
passages.sermon:
Binnui was the son of Henadad.
Binnui ruled half of the district of Keilah.
Their countrymen worked next to the previous builders.
Their countrymen made repairs under Binnui’s leadership.
passages.original: אַחֲרָיו֙ הֶחֱזִ֣יקוּ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם בַּוַּ֖י בֶּן־ חֵנָדָ֑ד שַׂ֕ר חֲצִ֖י פֶּ֥לֶךְ קְעִילָֽה׃ס

passages.text: And next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section opposite the Ascent to the Armory, near the angle in the wall.
passages.sermon:
Ezer was the son of Jeshua.
Ezer was the ruler of Mizpah.
Ezer repaired another section of the wall.
He worked next to the previous builder.
He repaired the section opposite the Ascent to the Armory.
This place was near the angle in the wall.
passages.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֨ק עַל־ יָד֜וֹ עֵ֧זֶר בֶּן־ יֵשׁ֛וּעַ שַׂ֥ר הַמִּצְפָּ֖ה מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֕גֶד עֲלֹ֥ת הַנֶּ֖שֶׁק הַמִּקְצֹֽעַ׃ס

passages.text: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai diligently repaired another section, from the angle to the doorway of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
passages.sermon:
Baruch was the son of Zabbai.
Baruch worked next to the previous builder.
Baruch repaired another section of the wall.
Baruch worked diligently.
Baruch repaired the section from the angle in the wall to the doorway.
The doorway belonged to the house of Eliashib.
Eliashib was the high priest.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֨יו הֶחֱרָ֧ה הֶחֱזִ֛יק בָּר֥וּךְ בֶּן־ זַבַּי מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִן־ הַ֨מִּקְצ֔וֹעַ עַד־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַגָּדֽוֹל׃ס

passages.text: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the doorway of the house of Eliashib to the end of the house.
passages.sermon:
Meremoth was the son of Uriah.  
Uriah was the son of Hakkoz.  
Meremoth worked next to the previous builder.  
He repaired another section of the wall.  
He started at the doorway of the house of Eliashib.  
He worked until the end of Eliashib’s house.  
Eliashib was the high priest.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְרֵמ֧וֹת בֶּן־ אוּרִיָּ֛ה בֶּן־ הַקּ֖וֹץ מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִפֶּ֙תַח֙ בֵּ֣ית אֶלְיָשִׁ֔יב וְעַד־ תַּכְלִ֖ית בֵּ֥ית אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃ס

passages.text: And next to him, the priests from the surrounding area made repairs.
passages.sermon:
The priests worked on the wall.
These priests came from the surrounding area.
They made repairs next to the previous worker.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַכִּכָּֽר׃

passages.text: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house, and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.
passages.sermon:
Benjamin and Hasshub worked on the wall.
They made repairs.
They worked in front of their house.
Azariah also worked on the wall.
Azariah was the son of Maaseiah.
Maaseiah was the son of Ananiah.
Azariah made repairs beside his house.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֨יו הֶחֱזִ֧יק בִּנְיָמִ֛ן וְחַשּׁ֖וּב נֶ֣גֶד בֵּיתָ֑םס אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק עֲזַרְיָ֧ה בֶן־ מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה בֶּן־ עֲנָֽנְיָ֖ה אֵ֥צֶל בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: After him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from the house of Azariah to the angle and the corner, and Palal son of Uzai made repairs opposite the angle and the tower that juts out from the upper palace of the king near the courtyard of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh and the temple servants living on the hill of Ophel made repairs opposite the Water Gate toward the east and the tower that juts out.
passages.sermon:
Binnui was the son of Henadad.
He repaired another section of the wall.
He worked after the previous builders.
He repaired from the house of Azariah to the angle and the corner.
Palal was the son of Uzai.
He repaired opposite the angle.
He also repaired opposite the tower that juts out.
This tower was part of the upper palace of the king.
The upper palace was near the courtyard of the guard.
Pedaiah was the son of Parosh.
He worked after Palal.
The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel.
Pedaiah and the temple servants repaired opposite the Water Gate.
The Water Gate was toward the east.
They also repaired opposite the tower that juts out.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק בִּנּ֛וּי בֶּן־ חֵנָדָ֖ד מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִבֵּ֣ית עֲזַרְיָ֔ה עַד־ הַמִּקְצ֖וֹעַ וְעַד־ הַפִּנָּֽה׃ פָּלָ֣ל בֶּן־ אוּזַי֮ מִנֶּ֣גֶד הַמִּקְצוֹעַ֒ וְהַמִּגְדָּ֗ל הַיּוֹצֵא֙ מִבֵּ֤ית הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הָֽעֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָ֑ה אַחֲרָ֖יו פְּדָיָ֥ה בֶן־ פַּרְעֹֽשׁ׃ס וְהַ֨נְּתִינִ֔ים הָי֥וּ יֹשְׁבִ֖ים בָּעֹ֑פֶל עַ֠ד נֶ֜גֶד שַׁ֤עַר הַמַּ֙יִם֙ לַמִּזְרָ֔ח וְהַמִּגְדָּ֖ל הַיּוֹצֵֽא׃ס

passages.text: And next to them, the Tekoites repaired another section, from a point opposite the great tower that juts out to the wall of Ophel.
passages.sermon:
The Tekoites were a group of workers from Tekoa.
They repaired another section of the wall.
They worked next to the previous builders.
They repaired from a point opposite the great tower that juts out.
They continued their repairs up to the wall of Ophel.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֛יו הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַתְּקֹעִ֖ים מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑ית מִנֶּ֜גֶד הַמִּגְדָּ֤ל הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔א וְעַ֖ד חוֹמַ֥ת הָעֹֽפֶל׃

passages.text: Above the Horse Gate, each of the priests made repairs in front of his own house.
passages.sermon: The priests worked above the Horse Gate.\r\nEach priest repaired the wall in front of his own house.
passages.original: מֵעַ֣ל׀ שַׁ֣עַר הַסּוּסִ֗ים הֶחֱזִ֙יקוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ לְנֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house, and next to him, Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, the guard of the East Gate, made repairs.
passages.sermon:
Zadok was the son of Immer.
Zadok made repairs.
He worked opposite his own house.
Shemaiah was the son of Shecaniah.
Shemaiah guarded the East Gate.
Shemaiah made repairs next to Zadok.
passages.original: אַחֲרָ֧יו הֶחֱזִ֛יק צָד֥וֹק בֶּן־ אִמֵּ֖ר נֶ֣גֶד בֵּית֑וֹס וְאַחֲרָ֤יו הֶחֱזִיק֙ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֣ה בֶן־ שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖ר שַׁ֥עַר הַמִּזְרָֽח׃ס

passages.text: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, as well as Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berechiah made repairs opposite his own quarters.
passages.sermon:
Hananiah was the son of Shelemiah.
Hanun was the sixth son of Zalaph.
Hananiah and Hanun repaired another section of the wall.
Meshullam was the son of Berechiah.
Meshullam made repairs next to them.
Meshullam repaired the part of the wall opposite his own quarters.
passages.original: אַחֲרַי הֶחֱזִ֜יק חֲנַנְיָ֣ה בֶן־ שֶׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְחָנ֧וּן בֶּן־ צָלָ֛ף הַשִּׁשִּׁ֖י מִדָּ֣ה שֵׁנִ֑יס אַחֲרָ֣יו הֶחֱזִ֗יק מְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן־ בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד נִשְׁכָּתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Next to him, Malchijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the upper room above the corner.
passages.sermon:
Malchijah was a goldsmith.
He worked on the wall.
He made repairs next to the previous worker.
He repaired the wall as far as the house of the temple servants.
He also repaired as far as the house of the merchants.
He worked opposite the Inspection Gate.
He repaired up to the upper room above the corner.
passages.original: אַחֲרֵי הֶחֱזִ֗יק מַלְכִּיָּה֙ בֶּן־ הַצֹּ֣רְפִ֔י עַד־ בֵּ֥ית הַנְּתִינִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִ֑ים נֶ֚גֶד שַׁ֣עַר הַמִּפְקָ֔ד וְעַ֖ד עֲלִיַּ֥ת הַפִּנָּֽה׃

passages.text: And between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and merchants made repairs.
passages.sermon: The goldsmiths and the merchants worked together.\r\nThey made repairs between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate.
passages.original: וּבֵ֨ין עֲלִיַּ֤ת הַפִּנָּה֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֶחֱזִ֥יקוּ הַצֹּרְפִ֖ים וְהָרֹכְלִֽים׃פ
